Identifying your target audience: Understanding demographics, psychographics, and behavioral patterns helps companies segment their market effectively.
Analyzing customer pain points: Recognizing what frustrates or challenges your customers allows you to develop solutions that address their specific needs.
Studying customer journey: Tracking how customers interact with your brand from initial awareness through purchase and beyond reveals critical touchpoints for improvement.
Gathering customer feedback: Regular surveys, interviews, and focus groups provide direct insights into customer satisfaction and expectations.
